production_code: backend/shots/lifecycle.py — pc-shots + pc-alternates lifecycle: ensure_shot, record_alternate (every generated clip = draft alternate), promote_to_continuity (transactional on the shot doc; previous cut retired), retire_alternate (revert path), lock_shot/unlock_shot (transactional), is_locked

backend/approvals/commands.py — four new fast-lane idempotent commands on default_registry: lock_shot, unlock_shot, add_to_continuity, remove_from_continuity (approval-tracked through H-0; no second action path)

backend/approvals/machine.py — _locked_target_result: central locked-target guard at dispatch AND redrive time; any command whose args.shot_id resolves to a locked shot fails with result.locked; only lock/unlock are exempt (LOCK_COMMANDS)
backend/api/spine.py — GET /projects/{id}/shots, GET /shots/{id} (with alternates), POST /shots/{id}/lock|unlock (propose-only; the flag never moves before approval)

covers: alternate lifecycle: record draft → promote to continuity → retire
promoting a new alternate retires the previous one (never overwritten, kept for revert)
lock/unlock route through the executor (approval-tracked), not a direct flag flip
locked-target guard refuses targeted commands at dispatch for any caller
lock/unlock commands remain executable on a locked shot
sweeper never redrives a crashed command whose target was locked after approval (crash-then-lock race)
API contract: lock route proposes through H-0; flag unmoved until approval; 404 on unknown shot

consumers: D-9 (Extend) records renders as alternates with op=extend
H-1h Continuity Agent reasons over locks + alternates (gated on this)
H-0b continuity adds ride the same approval-tracked commands
